integrity: The ratio recurrence is derived algebraically from the published complete-sweep determinant/Cauchy--Binet representation and fixed-weight conjugacy. The bundled decimal replay is supplementary and is not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact recurrence is proved for exactly three active distinct eigenvalues with nominal history length two and a fixed positive spectral weight.
The statement concerns exact arithmetic and strictly convex quadratics; finite-precision rank thresholds, trajectory-dependent weights, and nonquadratic objectives are outside scope.
Targeted database and full-text checks reduce but do not eliminate the possibility of an older equivalent statement under different spectral-gradient notation.
title: A square-root-two projective-instability law for three-mode rank-compressed LMSD
